result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a section heading is showing a raw localization key instead of the intended user-facing text.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the localized title text (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Resolve the missing localization string so the heading shows the correct translated text, or provide a fallback label.
